newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk asks for halt of Conrail poison pill.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk asks for halt of Conrail poison pill.

text.p: Norfolk Southern said on Friday that it had asked a federal judge in Philadelphia to block Conrail from executing a plan that would effectively force its shareholders to accept CSX's merger offer and prevent them from considering Norfolk Southern's higher offer for Conrail.
Norfolk Southern said it asked the court to stop Conrail from distributing its "Poison Pill" rights on November 7.
The distribution of the rights would essentially trigger Conrail's "poison pill" defense against any potential buyer except CSX, Norfolk said.
Judge Donald W. Van Artsdalen has tentatively scheduled a hearing on Norfolk Southern's motion for a temporary restraining order for noon on Monday, Norfolk said.
